name: session-objective
description: Every session has one objective file. The agent must rewrite it before it may act, may never silently drop anything the operator said, and may not end a turn while the objective is ACTIVE.

interface.shortDescription: One objective file per session: write before act, nothing said disappears, ACTIVE cannot end a turn.
interface.longDescription: Five hooks and one file per session. Every message you send is appended to an append-only ledger verbatim; until the agent rewrites the objective to reflect it, every tool call is refused. A constraint may only disappear behind a SUPERSEDED line naming it. A turn does not end while the objective is ACTIVE, and COMPLETE is accepted only when the hook re-runs each PROOF command and reproduces its recorded exit code.
